name: Josephson parametric oscillator for qubit measurement, amplitude encoded (Krantz 2016)
question: Does switching on the pump cross the qubit-shifted parametric threshold (threshold write), and with which law?
assumptions: i A' + eps A* + delta A + alpha |A|^2 A + i Gamma A = 0 (Krantz eq. 1), Gamma = 1; alpha = 27 kHz/1.32 MHz
qubit dispersive shift chi = +-2.75 Gamma enters as delta + chi
